appDesc.message: Right-click or point-and-pick to download anything: images at full quality, logos, fonts, video, whole designs.

popupEmptyTitle.message: Nothing captured on this page yet.

popupEmptyBody.message: Reload the page, then reopen this popup.

streamHint.message: Playlists describe streamed video — feed one to ffmpeg or yt-dlp where the site permits it.

noAccess.message: This page does not allow extensions (try a normal website).

optSubfolder.message: Save into a Grab Anything folder

optSubfolderSmall.message: Keeps grabs out of your Downloads root (applies to URL downloads)

optConvertSmall.message: Converts the formats that photo apps often refuse to open

optToastsSmall.message: Explains why a download failed instead of failing silently

optSniffer.message: Capture page media for the toolbar popup

optSnifferSmall.message: Watches this page's network requests so the popup can list every image, font and video it loaded. Nothing leaves your machine.

optComponentsSmall.message: Save the menu bar / hero / section under the cursor as a working web page file you can open and study

obTagline.message: If you can see it, you can save it.

obStep1P.message: Images download at the best quality the site has — not the shrunken thumbnail. Text offers the font used. Logos save as crisp SVG files. Menus, heroes and footers save as working design files.

obStep2H.message: Point and grab with the picker

obStep2P.message: Press Alt+Shift+G (or right-click → Pick what to grab). Move your mouse to highlight anything, scroll to widen the selection, click to save it as an image or a design file.

obStep3P.message: Pin the toolbar icon, then click it on any page: every image, video, and font the page fetched — download one, or all of them as a single ZIP. Plus one-click color palette and font cards.

obCta.message: Try it live on a photo-heavy page →

obNote.message: Everything runs on your device — no accounts, no tracking, nothing leaves your machine. Protected video streams (YouTube, Netflix) can't be saved; that's a browser-wide rule, not a missing feature.
